make -j{jobs} CFLAGS="-Wall -Winline -O2 -D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64"

set -euo pipefail
sed -i 's/^CC=gcc$/CC ?= gcc/' Makefile
sed -i 's/^CC=gcc$/CC ?= gcc/' Makefile-libbz2_so

set -euo pipefail
